intro: Goblin Engineering is a specialized craft path for master inventors who seek total mastery over explosive power and volatile concussive ordnance. Driven by high-yield blasting powders and relentless firepower, it offers an unapologetically destructive alternative to intricate tinkering.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can smell fresh recruits much like I can an excellent blasting powder - from a mile away. Have you come seeking to learn about the mastery of the explosion?
